lesson: A 3-4-1 inequality left of 1 is either a convergent test of the sign of Lambda (read set inside the P56 identification class; pole term dominates beyond log2/length of the line Re s=1) or a pointwise bound equal to the target. The group-law step reads each prime separately, so it carries no R1. T-NR is not a passer of log-level devices; with long tests it still satisfies the inequality at 0 of 1e5 random points negative (pole dominance), which shows truth of the inequality does not separate it.
